blocks.zh: 供應商、材料、元件及成品組件之確認與驗證（第一部分）
blocks.en: Qualification and Verification of Suppliers, Materials, Components and Finished Assemblies (Part 1)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Single-Use System (SUS) 供應商、材料與元件確認的風險導向與科學導向方法
blocks.en: Understand the risk-based and science-based approach to qualifying Single-Use System (SUS) suppliers, materials and components

blocks.zh: 掌握 SUS 使用所涉及的病患、製程與操作人員風險分類框架
blocks.en: Master the framework for classifying the risks that SUS use poses to the patient, the process and the operator

blocks.zh: 了解 SUS 組裝環境要求與供應商稽核的關鍵要素
blocks.en: Understand the environmental requirements for SUS assembly and the key elements of supplier audits

blocks.zh: 學習替代供應商確認、互換性評估與供應商品質文件的運用
blocks.en: Learn how to apply alternative supplier qualification, interchangeability assessment and supplier quality documentation

blocks.zh: 深入理解 Extractables and Leachables (E&L) 的定義、評估方法與對產品品質及病患安全的影響
blocks.en: Gain a thorough understanding of the definition of Extractables and Leachables (E&L), how they are assessed, and their impact on product quality and patient safety

blocks.zh: 5.0/5.1 Qualification and Verification — Introduction 5.0/5.1 確效與驗證 — 導論
blocks.en: 5.0/5.1 Qualification and Verification — Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Risk-based and Science-based Approach (風險導向與科學導向方法)：這是整個 SUS 確認流程的核心原則。不是所有 SUS 都需要相同程度的測試 — 風險越高的應用（例如長期儲存藥物原料藥），確認的深度與廣度就越大。科學導向則強調以數據驅動決策，而非單純依循慣例。
blocks.en: Risk-based and Science-based Approach: This is the core principle of the whole SUS qualification process. Not every SUS needs the same level of testing; the higher the risk of the application (for example, long-term storage of drug substance), the greater the depth and breadth of qualification. The science-based element stresses data-driven decisions rather than simply following convention.

blocks.zh: Supplier Quality Agreement (供應商品質協議)：這是終端使用者與 SUS 供應商之間的正式契約，規範品質期望、變更控制通知義務、稽核權利等。對於客製化設計尤其重要。
blocks.en: Supplier Quality Agreement: This is the formal contract between the end user and the SUS supplier. It sets out quality expectations, change control notification obligations, audit rights and so on. It is especially important for custom designs.

blocks.zh: Change Control (變更管控)：SUS 的供應鏈涉及多層次的供應商（樹脂廠、薄膜廠、組裝廠），任何一層的變更（如更換添加劑或製造廠址）都可能影響最終產品品質。
blocks.en: Change Control: The SUS supply chain involves several tiers of suppliers (resin manufacturers, film manufacturers, assemblers), and a change at any tier (such as a different additive or manufacturing site) can affect final product quality.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你經營一家高級餐廳，決定從陶瓷餐具（傳統不鏽鋼設備）改用高品質免洗餐具（SUS）。你不能隨便在大賣場買塑膠盤子就開始用 — 你需要確認供應商的食品安全認證、材料成分、耐溫性能，還要確保供應商若更換原料配方時會通知你。這就像 SUS 的確認流程：從原料樹脂到最終組裝，每一環都需要被驗證。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a high-end restaurant and decide to switch from ceramic tableware (traditional stainless steel equipment) to high-quality disposable tableware (SUS). You cannot simply buy plastic plates at a hypermarket and start using them. You need to confirm the supplier's food safety certification, material composition and temperature resistance, and make sure the supplier will notify you if they change the raw material formulation. This is just like SUS qualification: from the raw resin to the final assembly, every link has to be verified.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 確認文件清單是稽核的基礎：批號追溯、保質期、品質證書、完整性證書、內毒素認證、無動物源認證、滅菌認證 — 這些文件不僅是合規要求，更是製程出問題時追根溯源的關鍵工具。
blocks.en: The qualification document package is the basis of an audit: lot traceability, shelf life, quality certificates, integrity certificates, endotoxin certification, animal-origin-free certification and sterilization certification. These documents are not only a compliance requirement; they are also the key tools for tracing back to the root cause when the process goes wrong.

blocks.zh: 功能驗證三要素：風險評估（確認適用性）、製程驗證與確效（確認功能性）、安全性（確認壓力容器合規）。這三層驗證缺一不可。
blocks.en: Three elements of functional verification: risk assessment (confirms suitability), process validation and qualification (confirms functionality), and safety (confirms pressure vessel compliance). All three layers of verification are indispensable.

blocks.zh: 決策層級 Decision Hierarchy
blocks.en: Decision Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 1. 病患安全 Patient Safety
blocks.en: 1. Patient Safety

blocks.zh: 2. 產品 CQAs
blocks.en: 2. Product CQAs

blocks.zh: 3. 商業與供應鏈彈性
blocks.en: 3. Business and supply chain flexibility

blocks.zh: 在 SUS 確認中，所有決策都必須以病患安全為最高優先。即使供應鏈成本壓力很大，也不能犧牲確認的完整性。
blocks.en: In SUS qualification, every decision must give patient safety the highest priority. Even under heavy supply chain cost pressure, the completeness of qualification cannot be sacrificed.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR66 強調必須確認到「原始材料來源」(original sources of materials)？如果只稽核最終組裝商會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does TR66 stress that qualification must reach back to the "original sources of materials"? What risks arise if only the final assembler is audited?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 SUS 供應商沒有適當的變更評估流程，終端使用者應該採取什麼措施？這對 CDMO 的營運成本有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If a SUS supplier has no adequate change assessment process, what measures should the end user take? What does this mean for the operating costs of a CDMO?

blocks.zh: 列舉三種情境，說明同一類 SUS 在不同應用中可能需要不同深度的確認測試。
blocks.en: Give three scenarios showing why the same type of SUS may need different depths of qualification testing in different applications.

blocks.zh: 5.2 Risks Associated with Using Single-Use Systems 5.2 使用一次性使用系統之相關風險
blocks.en: 5.2 Risks Associated with Using Single-Use Systems

blocks.zh: 三類風險對象：SUS 使用的風險可分為對病患（最關鍵）、對製程（導致批次失敗）、對操作人員（安全危害）。TR66 特別聚焦於病患風險。
blocks.en: Three categories of risk targets: The risks of SUS use can be divided into risks to the patient (the most critical), to the process (leading to batch failure) and to the operator (safety hazards). TR66 focuses in particular on patient risk.

blocks.zh: 風險評估的關鍵參數：
blocks.en: Key parameters for risk assessment:

blocks.zh: 使用位置 (Point of use)：上游 vs 下游，離最終產品越近風險越高
blocks.en: Point of use: upstream vs downstream; the closer to the final product, the higher the risk

blocks.zh: 接觸時間 (Duration of contact)：>30天的長期儲存風險最大
blocks.en: Duration of contact: long-term storage of >30 days carries the greatest risk

blocks.zh: 製程條件：溫度、溶劑存在、表面積/體積比
blocks.en: Process conditions: temperature, presence of solvents, surface area/volume ratio

blocks.zh: Ishikawa Diagram (魚骨圖)：一種品質管理工具，用於系統性地識別造成問題的所有可能原因，將原因分類為人、機、料、法、環等大類別。
blocks.en: Ishikawa Diagram (fishbone diagram): A quality management tool used to systematically identify all possible causes of a problem, grouping the causes into major categories such as people, machines, materials, methods and environment.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 5.2-1🔍 解讀：這是一個 3x3 風險矩陣，橫軸為系統複雜度，縱軸為對製程的影響。右下角的 Fill and Finish（充填與完成）同時具有最高的系統複雜度和最高的製程影響 — 這是風險最高的應用場景。
blocks.en: Table 5.2-1🔍 interpretation: This is a 3x3 risk matrix, with system complexity on the horizontal axis and impact on the process on the vertical axis. Fill and Finish in the lower right corner has both the highest system complexity and the highest process impact, which makes it the highest-risk application scenario.

blocks.zh: 值得注意的是，Freeze/Thaw（冷凍/解凍）雖然系統複雜度低，但對製程影響高，因為它直接涉及產品品質（蛋白質凝聚、容器完整性等）。
blocks.en: Note that Freeze/Thaw, although low in system complexity, has a high impact on the process because it bears directly on product quality (protein aggregation, container integrity and so on).

blocks.zh: 風險分級就像建築安全等級：臨時工棚（非接觸系統）的安全要求最低，住宅（流體接觸系統）中等，醫院和核電廠（產品接觸與儲存系統）的安全標準最嚴格。越接近「最終使用者」（病患）的環節，品質要求就越高。
blocks.en: Risk classification is like building safety grades: a temporary work shed (non-contact system) has the lowest safety requirements, a residential building (fluid-contact system) is intermediate, and hospitals and nuclear power plants (product-contact and storage systems) have the strictest safety standards. The closer a step is to the "end user" (the patient), the higher the quality requirements.

blocks.zh: 上游 vs 下游風險差異：上游應用（如細胞培養）的風險相對較低，因為後續還有多道純化、過濾和清洗步驟可以去除或稀釋 leachables。但下游應用（如藥物原料藥儲存）沒有後續的純化機會，風險最高。
blocks.en: Upstream vs downstream risk differences: Upstream applications (such as cell culture) carry relatively lower risk because several later purification, filtration and washing steps can remove or dilute leachables. Downstream applications (such as drug substance storage) have no subsequent purification opportunity and therefore carry the highest risk.

blocks.zh: 四級風險分類（由低到高）：
blocks.en: Four risk classes (from low to high):

blocks.zh: 非流體接觸系統 — 排氣管路、取樣系統
blocks.en: Non-fluid-contact systems: vent lines, sampling systems

blocks.zh: 流體接觸系統 — 緩衝液袋、培養基袋
blocks.en: Fluid-contact systems: buffer bags, media bags

blocks.zh: 複雜系統 — 生物反應器、預配培養基
blocks.en: Complex systems: bioreactors, premixed media

blocks.zh: 產品接觸與儲存系統 — 管路、閥門、原料藥儲存容器
blocks.en: Product-contact and storage systems: tubing, valves, drug substance storage containers

blocks.zh: 在 Table 5.2-1🔍 中，為什麼 Purification/Product Storage 被歸類為「中等複雜度 + 高影響」而非「高複雜度 + 高影響」？
blocks.en: In Table 5.2-1🔍, why is Purification/Product Storage classified as "medium complexity + high impact" rather than "high complexity + high impact"?

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 同時為客戶生產上游細胞培養和下游純化步驟，在 SUS 確認策略上應該如何區分這兩種應用？
blocks.en: A CDMO produces both upstream cell culture and downstream purification steps for clients. How should it differentiate between these two applications in its SUS qualification strategy?

blocks.zh: 5.3 Single-Use System Assembly 5.3 一次性使用系統組裝
blocks.en: 5.3 Single-Use System Assembly

blocks.zh: SUS 組裝環境要求：SUS 元件通常在環境控制要求較低的區域接收與存放，但組裝必須在 ISO 7 或 ISO 8 等級的潔淨室中進行。這與傳統不鏽鋼設備的製造環境（通常為一般工廠環境）有顯著不同。
blocks.en: SUS assembly environment requirements: SUS components are usually received and stored in areas with lower environmental control requirements, but assembly must take place in a cleanroom of ISO 7 or ISO 8 class. This differs markedly from the manufacturing environment of traditional stainless steel equipment (usually a general factory environment).

blocks.zh: 關鍵控制措施：密封包裝保持完整、戴手套操作、外包裝消毒擦拭、HEPA 過濾空氣、人員培訓與著裝、避免尖銳物品。
blocks.en: Key controls: keep sealed packaging intact, handle with gloves, disinfect or wipe down outer packaging, use HEPA-filtered air, provide personnel training and gowning, and avoid sharp objects.

blocks.zh: SUS 組裝就像在手術室中組裝無菌器材 — 你不能在走廊上打開無菌包裝。即使元件本身已經包裝好了，組裝的環境也必須達到一定的潔淨度，因為組裝過程中的任何污染都可能被密封在最終的系統裡。特別提到「避免尖銳邊角」就像手術室不允許有可能刺破手術手套的物品一樣。
blocks.en: SUS assembly is like assembling sterile instruments in an operating room: you would not open sterile packaging in a corridor. Even if the components are already packaged, the assembly environment must reach a certain cleanliness, because any contamination introduced during assembly can be sealed inside the final system. The specific mention of "avoiding sharp edges and corners" is like an operating room not allowing anything that could puncture a surgical glove.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務考量：如果 CDMO 自行組裝 SUS，就必須維護符合 ISO 7/8 標準的專用組裝室，包括環境監測計畫（粒子計數 + 微生物取樣）。若選擇由供應商預組裝 (preassembled)，則這些責任轉移給供應商 — 但稽核責任仍在 CDMO 身上。
blocks.en: CDMO practical considerations: If the CDMO assembles SUS in-house, it must maintain a dedicated assembly room that meets ISO 7/8, including an environmental monitoring program (particle counts + microbial sampling). If it chooses preassembled systems from the supplier, these responsibilities shift to the supplier, but the audit responsibility remains with the CDMO.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SUS 元件可以在「最小環境控制」區域存放，但組裝必須在 ISO 7/8 潔淨室？這兩者的風險差異是什麼？
blocks.en: Why can SUS components be stored in a "minimal environmental control" area while assembly must take place in an ISO 7/8 cleanroom? What is the difference in risk between the two?

blocks.zh: 如果你是 CDMO 的品質主管，你會選擇自行組裝 SUS 還是採購預組裝系統？各有什麼優缺點？
blocks.en: If you were the head of quality at a CDMO, would you choose to assemble SUS in-house or purchase preassembled systems? What are the advantages and disadvantages of each?

blocks.zh: 5.4 Supplier Qualification of Single-Use Systems 5.4 一次性使用系統之供應商確效
blocks.en: 5.4 Supplier Qualification of Single-Use Systems

blocks.zh: Supplier Qualification (供應商確認)：這不只是簡單的「核准供應商清單」管理。對 SUS 供應商的確認需要深入了解其品質體系、製造能力、技術專業度，以及最重要的 — 變更管控流程。
blocks.en: Supplier Qualification: This is more than simply managing an "approved supplier list". Qualifying a SUS supplier requires an in-depth understanding of its quality system, manufacturing capability and technical expertise, and above all its change control process.

blocks.zh: ISO 9001：通用品質管理體系標準，是 SUS 供應商的最低要求
blocks.en: ISO 9001: general quality management system standard; the minimum requirement for SUS suppliers

blocks.zh: ISO 13485：醫療器材品質管理體系標準
blocks.en: ISO 13485: quality management system standard for medical devices

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 820：FDA 醫療器材 cGMP 法規
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 820: FDA cGMP regulation for medical devices

blocks.zh: 重要區分：SUS 被視為製程設備而非醫療器材，因此其製造設施不受法規註冊或查廠的約束。這意味著終端使用者的稽核責任更重。
blocks.en: Important distinction: SUS are regarded as process equipment rather than medical devices, so their manufacturing facilities are not subject to regulatory registration or inspection. This means the end user carries a heavier audit responsibility.

blocks.zh: SUS 供應商的角色就像餐廳的食材供應商 — 他們不受「餐飲業衛生法規」直接管轄（SUS 不是醫療器材），但你的餐廳（藥廠）出了食安問題，最終責任還是在你身上。所以你必須主動去稽核你的食材供應商的衛生管理、冷鏈控制、變更通知機制等，而不能只依賴他們的「自我聲明」。
blocks.en: The role of a SUS supplier is like that of a restaurant's food ingredient supplier. They are not directly governed by "food service hygiene regulations" (SUS are not medical devices), but if your restaurant (the pharmaceutical plant) has a food safety problem, the ultimate responsibility is still yours. So you must proactively audit your ingredient suppliers' hygiene management, cold chain control, change notification mechanisms and so on, and cannot rely only on their "self-declaration".

blocks.zh: SUS 稽核的獨特重點：
blocks.en: Unique audit focus areas for SUS:

blocks.zh: 變更定義與通知：供應商如何定義「變更」？多小的改變需要通知客戶？這在 SUS 中至關重要，因為即使微小的樹脂配方變更也可能改變 E&L profile
blocks.en: Definition of change and notification: How does the supplier define a "change"? How small a change requires notifying the customer? This is critical for SUS, because even a minor change in resin formulation may alter the E&L profile.

blocks.zh: 微粒控制：SUS 中的微粒是長期以來的產業痛點，必須評估供應商的微粒控制與減少方案
blocks.en: Particulate control: Particulates in SUS have long been an industry pain point, and the supplier's particulate control and reduction program must be evaluated.

blocks.zh: 伽馬射線滅菌劑量稽核：季度劑量稽核記錄是確認滅菌有效性的關鍵
blocks.en: Gamma sterilization dose audit: Quarterly dose audit records are the key to confirming sterilization effectiveness.

blocks.zh: 合作夥伴心態 (Partnership Mindset)：TR66 特別強調 SUS 供應商將「不可避免地成為終端使用者製造和品質體系的延伸」。這不是一般的買賣關係，而是深度合作關係。
blocks.en: Partnership Mindset: TR66 particularly emphasizes that SUS suppliers will "inevitably become an extension of the end user's manufacturing and quality systems". This is not an ordinary buyer-seller relationship but a deep collaboration.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：假設你的 CDMO 同時服務 5 個客戶，每個客戶使用不同的 SUS 配置。你不可能為每個客戶維護完全獨立的供應商確認體系。實務上，你需要建立一個「平台化」的供應商確認框架 — 先確認核心供應商（薄膜、管路、連接器等），再根據個別客戶的產品風險等級決定是否需要額外的專案級確認。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Suppose your CDMO serves 5 clients at the same time, each using a different SUS configuration. You cannot maintain a completely separate supplier qualification system for every client. In practice, you need to build a "platform" supplier qualification framework: first qualify the core suppliers (film, tubing, connectors and so on), then decide, based on each client's product risk level, whether additional project-level qualification is needed.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SUS 被歸類為「製程設備」而非「醫療器材」？這個分類對終端使用者有什麼實際影響？
blocks.en: Why are SUS classified as "process equipment" rather than "medical devices"? What practical impact does this classification have on the end user?

blocks.zh: 在供應商品質協議中，「變更控制」條款應該涵蓋哪些具體項目？請至少列出五項。
blocks.en: In a supplier quality agreement, what specific items should the "change control" clause cover? List at least five.

blocks.zh: 如果一個 SUS 供應商只有 ISO 9001 認證而沒有 ISO 13485，這是否足夠？為什麼 TR66 認為 ISO 9001 是最低要求？
blocks.en: If a SUS supplier holds only ISO 9001 certification and not ISO 13485, is that sufficient? Why does TR66 regard ISO 9001 as the minimum requirement?

blocks.zh: 5.5 Qualification of Alternative Suppliers 5.5 替代供應商確效
blocks.en: 5.5 Qualification of Alternative Suppliers

blocks.zh: Alternative Supplier (替代供應商)：SUS 供應鏈的一大風險是單一來源依賴。TR66 明確建議確認替代供應商作為風險管理的一部分。替代來源有兩種選擇：
blocks.en: Alternative Supplier: A major risk in the SUS supply chain is single-source dependence. TR66 explicitly recommends qualifying alternative suppliers as part of risk management. There are two options for an alternative source:

blocks.zh: 同一供應商 + 替代原料來源：風險較低，但仍需評估 E&L profile 差異
blocks.en: Same supplier + alternative raw material source: lower risk, but differences in the E&L profile still need to be assessed

blocks.zh: 完全替代供應商：風險較高，高風險應用需要完整的確認流程
blocks.en: Completely alternative supplier: higher risk; high-risk applications require a full qualification process

blocks.zh: Interchangeability (互換性)：三個層級的替代 —
blocks.en: Interchangeability: three levels of substitution —

blocks.zh: Like-for-like (同等替換)：相同材料、尺寸，不同供應商 → 最簡單的確認
blocks.en: Like-for-like: same material and dimensions, different supplier → the simplest qualification

blocks.zh: Functionally equivalent (功能等效)：不同材料但相同性能 → 需要監測 CQAs
blocks.en: Functionally equivalent: different material but the same performance → CQAs need to be monitored

blocks.zh: Process modification (製程修改)：不同設計和材料 → 需要縮小規模開發研究
blocks.en: Process modification: different design and materials → scale-down development studies are needed

blocks.zh: 互換性就像汽車零件的替換策略：
blocks.en: Interchangeability is like replacement strategies for car parts:

blocks.zh: Like-for-like：原廠輪胎用另一家同規格原廠輪胎替換 — 只需確認尺寸和性能規格
blocks.en: Like-for-like: replacing an original-equipment tire with another original-equipment tire of the same specification; only the size and performance specifications need to be confirmed

blocks.zh: Functionally equivalent：換成不同品牌但同規格的副廠輪胎 — 需要測試抓地力、耐磨性等性能
blocks.en: Functionally equivalent: switching to an aftermarket tire of a different brand but the same specification; performance such as grip and wear resistance needs to be tested

blocks.zh: Process modification：從普通輪胎換成雪地輪胎 — 需要重新評估整車操控性能
blocks.en: Process modification: changing from ordinary tires to snow tires; the vehicle's handling performance needs to be re-evaluated as a whole

blocks.zh: 越往下，需要的測試和驗證越多，成本也越高。
blocks.en: The further down the list, the more testing and verification are needed, and the higher the cost.

blocks.zh: Table 5.5.2-1🔍 解讀：這張表是互換性評估的核心框架。注意風險評估焦點的編號：
blocks.en: Table 5.5.2-1🔍 interpretation: This table is the core framework for interchangeability assessment. Note the numbering of the risk assessment focus areas:

blocks.zh: Like-for-like 只需要 1、2（設計規格 + 材料相容性）
blocks.en: Like-for-like needs only 1 and 2 (design specifications + material compatibility)

blocks.zh: Functionally equivalent 增加了 3、4、6（生物安全 + E&L + 產品影響）
blocks.en: Functionally equivalent adds 3, 4 and 6 (biosafety + E&L + product impact)

blocks.zh: Process modification 再增加 5（後續 leachable 去除可能性）
blocks.en: Process modification adds 5 (the possibility of subsequent leachable removal)

blocks.zh: Table 5.5.3-1🔍 啟示：三家供應商的測試範圍差異很大！Vendor C 甚至「除非客戶要求，否則不做 E&L 測試」。這凸顯了供應商之間缺乏標準化的現實，也說明為什麼終端使用者的稽核如此重要。
blocks.en: Table 5.5.3-1🔍 takeaway: The scope of testing differs greatly among the three suppliers! Vendor C even "does not perform E&L testing unless requested by the customer". This highlights the lack of standardization between suppliers and explains why end-user audits are so important.

blocks.zh: Cost of Quality (品質成本)：TR66 提出一個重要觀點 — 互換性測試的成本應該納入 SUS 總實施成本中。如果供應商能做到完美的互換性（理想情況），這個成本就是零。現實中，終端使用者必須投入額外的測試資源來驗證替代供應商的適用性。
blocks.en: Cost of Quality: TR66 makes an important point: the cost of interchangeability testing should be included in the total cost of implementing SUS. If a supplier could achieve perfect interchangeability (the ideal case), this cost would be zero. In reality, end users must invest additional testing resources to verify the suitability of an alternative supplier.

blocks.zh: GEP (Good Engineering Practices)：良好工程實務是利用供應商文件進行驗證的前提條件。如果供應商未嚴格遵循 GEP，終端使用者就需要額外確認文件的準確性和適用性。
blocks.en: GEP (Good Engineering Practices): Good engineering practice is a prerequisite for using supplier documentation in validation. If the supplier does not strictly follow GEP, the end user needs additional confirmation of the accuracy and applicability of the documentation.

blocks.zh: 供應鏈韌性場景：2020 年 COVID-19 疫情期間，許多 CDMO 面臨 SUS 供應短缺。那些事先確認了替代供應商的企業能夠快速切換供應源，維持生產不中斷。沒有替代供應商的企業則面臨數週甚至數月的停產。這個案例生動地說明了為什麼 TR66 如此強調替代供應商確認的重要性。
blocks.en: Supply chain resilience scenario: During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, many CDMOs faced SUS supply shortages. Companies that had already qualified alternative suppliers could switch sources quickly and keep production running. Companies without alternative suppliers faced weeks or even months of production stoppage. This case vividly illustrates why TR66 places such emphasis on qualifying alternative suppliers.

blocks.zh: 在 Table 5.5.2-1🔍 中，為什麼 like-for-like 替換不需要風險評估焦點 3（生物安全數據）？
blocks.en: In Table 5.5.2-1🔍, why does a like-for-like replacement not need risk assessment focus 3 (biosafety data)?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 CDMO 需要為生物反應器袋確認替代供應商，應該採用哪個層級的互換性評估？需要做哪些具體測試？
blocks.en: If a CDMO needs to qualify an alternative supplier for bioreactor bags, which level of interchangeability assessment should it use? What specific tests are needed?

blocks.zh: Table 5.5.3-1🔍 顯示供應商之間的測試差異很大。作為終端使用者，你會如何利用這張表來強化你的供應商管理策略？
blocks.en: Table 5.5.3-1🔍 shows large differences in testing between suppliers. As an end user, how would you use this table to strengthen your supplier management strategy?

blocks.zh: 5.6 Extractables and Leachables (E&L) 5.6 可萃取物與溶出物（E&L）
blocks.en: 5.6 Extractables and Leachables (E&L)

blocks.zh: Extractables (可萃取物)：在極端條件下（強溶劑、高溫、極端 pH）從材料中「強制提取」出來的化學物質。這代表了最壞情況的完整化學圖譜。
blocks.en: Extractables: Chemical substances "forcibly extracted" from a material under extreme conditions (strong solvents, high temperature, extreme pH). They represent the complete worst-case chemical profile.

blocks.zh: Leachables (溶出物)：在正常製程或儲存條件下，從材料表面遷移到製程流體或產品中的化學物質。Leachables 是 extractables 的子集，但也可能包含在製程條件下產生的新反應產物。
blocks.en: Leachables: Chemical substances that migrate from the material surface into the process fluid or product under normal process or storage conditions. Leachables are a subset of extractables, but may also include new reaction products formed under process conditions.

blocks.zh: In-process Leachables (製程中溶出物)：在中間製程步驟中溶出、但可被後續純化步驟清除或稀釋至不可檢測水平的物質。雖然最終不會出現在成品中，但仍需在風險評估中考量。
blocks.en: In-process Leachables: Substances that leach during intermediate process steps but can be removed by subsequent purification steps or diluted to undetectable levels. Although they will not ultimately appear in the finished product, they still need to be considered in the risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 關鍵區別：Extractables 研究用極端條件建立「化學地圖」，Leachables 研究則用實際條件確認「真實風險」。兩者互補，缺一不可。
blocks.en: Key difference: Extractables studies use extreme conditions to build a "chemical map", whereas leachables studies use actual conditions to confirm the "real risk". The two are complementary and neither can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 想像一個新買的水壺：
blocks.en: Imagine a newly bought water bottle:

blocks.zh: Extractables 研究：就像用沸水、醋、酒精分別浸泡水壺 90 天，看看到底能「逼」出什麼物質 — 這是壓力測試
blocks.en: Extractables study: like soaking the bottle in boiling water, vinegar and alcohol separately for 90 days to see what can be "forced" out of it; this is a stress test

blocks.zh: Leachables 研究：就像正常使用水壺泡茶、裝水，看看日常使用下會有什麼物質溶出 — 這是真實情境
blocks.en: Leachables study: like using the bottle normally to brew tea or hold water, to see what leaches out in everyday use; this is the real-world scenario

blocks.zh: In-process leachables：就像水壺裝的水還會再經過濾水器 — 即使溶出了東西，後續過濾也能去除
blocks.en: In-process leachables: like the water in the bottle then passing through a water filter; even if something leaches out, the subsequent filtration can remove it

blocks.zh: 你需要先做壓力測試（extractables）建立完整的風險圖譜，再做日常測試（leachables）確認實際風險。
blocks.en: You first need the stress test (extractables) to build a complete risk map, and then the everyday test (leachables) to confirm the actual risk.

blocks.zh: E&L 遷移的科學原理：
blocks.en: Scientific principles of E&L migration:

blocks.zh: 熱力學因素：決定物質遷移的程度（平衡狀態下能遷移多少）
blocks.en: Thermodynamic factors: determine the extent of migration (how much can migrate at equilibrium)

blocks.zh: 動力學因素：決定物質遷移的速率（多快達到平衡）
blocks.en: Kinetic factors: determine the rate of migration (how quickly equilibrium is reached)

blocks.zh: 時間因素：接觸時間越長，遷移量越大
blocks.en: Time factor: the longer the contact time, the greater the amount migrated

blocks.zh: 溫度效應：溫度越高，遷移速率越快
blocks.en: Temperature effect: the higher the temperature, the faster the migration rate

blocks.zh: Leachables 的危害：毒性、致癌性、免疫原性、內分泌干擾。此外還可能導致蛋白質聚集、氧化、降解和微粒形成 — 直接影響產品 CQAs。
blocks.en: Hazards of leachables: toxicity, carcinogenicity, immunogenicity and endocrine disruption. They may also cause protein aggregation, oxidation, degradation and particle formation, directly affecting product CQAs.

blocks.zh: Extractables 研究設計要點：
blocks.en: Key points in designing extractables studies:

blocks.zh: 使用極端條件（非正常製程條件）：極端 pH、高溫、長時間、高表面積/體積比
blocks.en: Use extreme conditions (not normal process conditions): extreme pH, high temperature, long duration, high surface area/volume ratio

blocks.zh: 使用不同極性的有機溶劑作為萃取介質
blocks.en: Use organic solvents of different polarities as extraction media

blocks.zh: 如果常規製程中有預沖洗步驟 → 應包含在 leachables 研究中，但不應包含在 extractables 研究中（因為 extractables 代表最壞情況）
blocks.en: If the routine process includes a pre-rinse step → it should be included in the leachables study but should not be included in the extractables study (because extractables represent the worst case)

blocks.zh: 伽馬射線照射和蒸汽處理等預處理也會影響 E&L 圖譜
blocks.en: Pretreatments such as gamma irradiation and steam treatment also affect the E&L profile

blocks.zh: 毒理學評估：
blocks.en: Toxicological assessment:

blocks.zh: 已知物質：參考 ICH Q3C (R3) 殘留溶劑指南中的安全閾值
blocks.en: Known substances: refer to the safety thresholds in the ICH Q3C (R3) residual solvents guideline

blocks.zh: 未知物質：使用 TTC (Threshold of Toxicological Concern，毒理學關注閾值) 方法評估風險
blocks.en: Unknown substances: assess the risk using the TTC (Threshold of Toxicological Concern) approach

blocks.zh: 細胞培養的特殊風險：研究已證實伽馬射線照射分解的抗氧化劑可在 sub-ppm（低於百萬分之一）的濃度下，以細胞株特異性的方式影響細胞培養活力。這意味著：
blocks.en: Special risks in cell culture: Studies have shown that antioxidants degraded by gamma irradiation can affect cell culture viability, in a cell line-specific manner, at concentrations in the sub-ppm range (below one part per million). This means:

blocks.zh: 不能僅依賴 chemical E&L 數據 — 必須進行細胞功能性測試
blocks.en: You cannot rely on chemical E&L data alone; cell-based functional testing must be performed

blocks.zh: 不同細胞株的敏感度不同 — 需要針對特定細胞株測試
blocks.en: Different cell lines have different sensitivities; testing against the specific cell line is needed

blocks.zh: 培養基儲存袋和生物反應器袋是高風險應用
blocks.en: Media storage bags and bioreactor bags are high-risk applications

blocks.zh: 雙向交互作用：不僅塑膠會向溶液釋放物質（leaching），溶液中的成分也可能被塑膠表面吸附（adsorption）。兩個方向都需要評估。
blocks.en: Two-way interaction: Not only can plastics release substances into the solution (leaching), but components of the solution can also be adsorbed onto the plastic surface (adsorption). Both directions need to be assessed.

blocks.zh: CDMO E&L 策略：作為 CDMO，你可能同時生產多種生物製劑產品。建議建立一個「平台 E&L 資料庫」：
blocks.en: CDMO E&L strategy: As a CDMO, you may produce many biologic products at the same time. It is recommended to build a "platform E&L database":

blocks.zh: 對所有常用的 SUS 元件（薄膜、管路、連接器、過濾器）進行一次全面的 extractables 研究
blocks.en: Conduct one comprehensive extractables study on all commonly used SUS components (film, tubing, connectors, filters)

blocks.zh: 建立基準數據庫，新客戶產品導入時只需進行針對性的 leachables 確認
blocks.en: Build a baseline database, so that when a new client product is introduced only a targeted leachables confirmation is needed

blocks.zh: 這可以大幅降低每個新專案的 E&L 評估時間和成本
blocks.en: This can greatly reduce the E&L assessment time and cost of each new project

blocks.zh: 為什麼 extractables 研究不應包含預沖洗步驟，但 leachables 研究應該包含？這反映了兩種研究的根本設計哲學有何不同？
blocks.en: Why should an extractables study not include the pre-rinse step while a leachables study should? What does this say about the fundamental difference in design philosophy between the two types of study?

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 客戶要求將 CHO 細胞培養的生物反應器袋從供應商 A 換成供應商 B。請列出你需要進行的 E&L 相關測試清單。
blocks.en: A CDMO client asks to change the bioreactor bag for CHO cell culture from supplier A to supplier B. List the E&L-related tests you would need to perform.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TOC 分析不能用於含碳溶劑的萃取液？有什麼替代方法？
blocks.en: Why can TOC analysis not be used for extracts made with carbon-containing solvents? What alternative methods are there?

blocks.zh: 解釋 TTC (Threshold of Toxicological Concern) 方法在什麼情況下使用，以及它的局限性是什麼。
blocks.en: Explain when the TTC (Threshold of Toxicological Concern) approach is used and what its limitations are.

blocks.zh: 分析方法工具箱 Analytical Methods
blocks.en: Analytical Methods

blocks.zh: E&L 測試需要多種互補的分析技術：
blocks.en: E&L testing requires a range of complementary analytical techniques:

blocks.zh: 參考標準：USP <661>、USP <381>、BPOG 和 BPSA 標準化測試方案。
blocks.en: Reference standards: USP <661>, USP <381>, and the BPOG and BPSA standardized test protocols.
